question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error: **

Little did the committee knew (1)/ about the hidden liabilities (2)/ when it approved the merger (3)/ late last quarter. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in part 1 of the sentence: "**Little did the committee knew**."
 
• The phrase "Little did" is followed by the base form of the verb, not the past tense. Therefore, "knew" is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**Little did the committee know**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.
